ffmpeg.install:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat
    %make_install

    # Version libs
    pushd %(installroot)
    f=""
    for f in usr/lib/ffmpeg-8.1/*; do
        if [[ $f == *.so ]]; then
            ln -srf -- usr/lib/"$(readlink "$f")" "$f"
            mv "$f" "${f%%.so}-8.1.so"
        elif [[ ! -d $f ]]; then
            mv "$f" usr/lib
        fi
    done

    # Rename pkgconfigs so they don't conflict
    mv %(installroot)%(libdir)/ffmpeg-8.1/pkgconfig %(installroot)%(libdir)/pkgconfig
    cd %(installroot)%(libdir)/pkgconfig
    for i in *.pc; do
        mv $i ${i%.pc}-8.1.pc
    done

    # Fixup pkgconfig dependencies
    for b in avcodec avdevice avfilter avformat avutil postproc swresample swscale; do
        sed -i "s|lib$b|lib$b-8.1|g" *.pc
        sed -i "s|-l$b|-l$b-8.1|g" *.pc
    done
    popd

    # Delete everything unversioned
    rm -rfv %(installroot)%(bindir)/ \
            %(installroot)%(datadir)/ffmpeg \
            %(installroot)%(docdir) \
            %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1 \
            %(installroot)%(mandir)/man3
    rmdir -v %(installroot)%(mandir) \
            %(installroot)%(datadir)
    popd
fi

%make_install

# Deprecated lib(s)
for i in libpostproc{,-devel}; do
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(docdir)/${i}
    echo "DEPRECATED" > %(installroot)%(docdir)/${i}/README
done

firefox.build:
./mach build
if [ $FULL_BUILD -ne 0 ]; then
    ./mach package

    # PGO
    # Much of this taken from https://github.com/chaotic-aur/packages/blob/main/firefox-nightly/PKGBUILD
    env \
        JARLOG_FILE="${PWD}/jarlog" \
        LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=true \
        LLVM_PROFDATA="${LLVM_PROFDATA:-llvm-profdata}" \
        MOZ_REMOTE_SETTINGS_DEVTOOLS=1 \
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$(mktemp -p $(pwd) -d xdg-runtime-XXXXXX)" \
    dbus-run-session \
        wlheadless-run \
            -c weston --width=1920 --height=1080 \
            -- ./mach python build/pgo/profileserver.py

    # Make sure PGO data is present
    stat -c "Profile data found (%%s bytes)" merged.profdata
    test -s merged.profdata
    stat -c "Jar log found (%%s bytes)" jarlog
    test -s jarlog

    # Delete instrumented browser
    ./mach clobber objdir

    # Reset mozconfig
    cp mozconfig.save mozconfig

    # Enable LTO
    echo "ac_add_options MOZ_LTO=cross,full" >> mozconfig
    echo "ac_add_options --enable-lto=cross,full" >> mozconfig

    # PGO
    echo "ac_add_options --enable-profile-use=cross" >> mozconfig
    echo "ac_add_options --with-pgo-profile-path=${PWD}/merged.profdata" >> mozconfig
    echo "ac_add_options --with-pgo-jarlog=${PWD}/jarlog" >> mozconfig

    ./mach build
fi

%install_file shell/key-bindings.fish %(installroot)%(datadir)/fish/vendor_functions.d/fzf_key_bindings.fish

# Shell completions
%install_file shell/completion.bash %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/fzf
%install_file shell/completion.zsh %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_fzf
%install_file shell/completion.fish %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/fzf.fish

%install_file doc/fzf.txt %(installroot)%(datadir)/vim/vimfiles/doc/fzf.txt
%install_file plugin/fzf.vim %(installroot)%(datadir)/vim/vimfiles/plugin/fzf.vim
